item.description: Millwall travel to Preston North End in the Sky Bet Championship on Saturday afternoon (kick-off 3pm). item.title: Under 21s suffer defeat on the road
item.description: Millwall Under 21s suffered a 2-0 away defeat at Sparrows Lane on Friday afternoon. The Reds had the first chance of the game as they sent a free kick from the right flank into the box, which met the head of Josh Laqeretabua, whose header that followed was saved low by Ronnie Sandford. Set-pieces continued to deliver the best openings for the hosts, as the ball fell kindly to Kaheim Dixon following a corner and the forward fired a powerful effort which was well saved at Sandford’s near post. item.title: Lenny and Luke see off Preston at Deepdale
item.description: Millwall were 2-0 winners against Preston North End at Deepdale on Saturday afternoon. Ryan Leonard scored his first Championship goal of the season - and a third in all competitions - in the first-half to give Alex Neil's side the lead, with Luke Cundle stepping off the bench to secure a third straight away win in second-half stoppage-time.
